verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component with no product UI or service API, so API-to-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The developer toolkits (oneAPI, OpenVINO) and the intel.com probes are adjacent ecosystem material and do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
